# A mountain pine: a short trunk and two stacked faceted cones. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 5 --radius 0.1 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
material new Bark --base-color 0.604 0.388 0.282
material assign Bark
add mesh cone --name Low --vertices 6 --radius1 0.55 --radius2 0.12 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 0.75
add mesh cone --name Top --vertices 6 --radius1 0.4 --radius2 0 --depth 0.75 --location 0 0 1.3 --rotation 0 0 30
material new Needles --base-color 0.392 0.490 0.204
select Low Top
material assign Needles
select all
shade flat
export pine.glb
